experiences_age_rule_limits.name: experiences_age_rule_limits
experiences_age_rule_limits.value:
(
        "experiences"."age_rule" IN ('all_ages', 'twenty_one_plus')
          AND "experiences"."min_age" IS NULL AND "experiences"."max_age" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "experiences"."age_rule" = 'minimum_age'
          AND "experiences"."min_age" IS NOT NULL AND "experiences"."min_age" >= 0
          AND "experiences"."max_age" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "experiences"."age_rule" = 'age_range'
          AND "experiences"."min_age" IS NOT NULL AND "experiences"."min_age" >= 0
          AND "experiences"."max_age" IS NOT NULL AND "experiences"."max_age" >= "experiences"."min_age"
      )

experiences_weather_decision_hours.name: experiences_weather_decision_hours
experiences_weather_decision_hours.value:
coalesce("experiences"."weather_policy" = 'decided_before_start', false)
        = ("experiences"."weather_decision_hours" IS NOT NULL)
        AND coalesce("experiences"."weather_decision_hours" > 0, true)

photos_alt_or_decorative.name: photos_alt_or_decorative
photos_alt_or_decorative.value:
("photos"."decorative" AND "photos"."alt_text" IS NULL) OR (
        NOT "photos"."decorative"
          AND "photos"."alt_text" IS NOT NULL
          AND char_length("photos"."alt_text") BETWEEN 1 AND 300
          AND "photos"."alt_text" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
      )

photos_rights_holder.name: photos_rights_holder
photos_rights_holder.value: "photos"."rights_holder" IS NULL OR (char_length("photos"."rights_holder") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "photos"."rights_holder" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

photos_rights_license.name: photos_rights_license
photos_rights_license.value: "photos"."rights_license" IS NULL OR (char_length("photos"."rights_license") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "photos"."rights_license" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

photos_rights_licensed_complete.name: photos_rights_licensed_complete
photos_rights_licensed_complete.value:
"photos"."rights_basis" <> 'licensed' OR (
        "photos"."rights_holder" IS NOT NULL
          AND "photos"."rights_license" IS NOT NULL
          AND "photos"."rights_source_url" IS NOT NULL
      )

photos_rights_unlicensed_bare.name: photos_rights_unlicensed_bare
photos_rights_unlicensed_bare.value: "photos"."rights_basis" = 'licensed' OR ("photos"."rights_license" IS NULL AND "photos"."rights_source_url" IS NULL)

legal_documents_dates_in_range.name: legal_documents_dates_in_range
legal_documents_dates_in_range.value:
"legal_documents"."created_at" >= '1000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND "legal_documents"."created_at" < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'
        AND ("legal_documents"."published_at" IS NULL OR ("legal_documents"."published_at" >= '1000-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND "legal_documents"."published_at" < '10000-01-01 00:00:00+00'))

collections_intro_is_rich_text.name: collections_intro_is_rich_text
collections_intro_is_rich_text.value:
"collections"."intro" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("collections"."intro") = 'object'
    AND coalesce("collections"."intro"->>'type', '') = 'doc'
    AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("collections"."intro"->'content'), '') = 'array'
    AND octet_length("collections"."intro"::text) <= 200000)

consents_source_allows_status.name: consents_source_allows_status
consents_source_allows_status.value: ("consents"."source" = 'checkout' AND "consents"."status" IN ('granted')) OR ("consents"."source" = 'unsubscribe' AND "consents"."status" IN ('withdrawn')) OR ("consents"."source" = 'ops' AND "consents"."status" IN ('granted', 'withdrawn')) OR ("consents"."source" = 'erasure' AND "consents"."status" IN ('withdrawn'))

messages_body_only_for_fake_adapter.name: messages_body_only_for_fake_adapter
messages_body_only_for_fake_adapter.value: "messages"."adapter" = 'fake' OR ("messages"."html" IS NULL AND "messages"."text_body" IS NULL)

messages_body_length.name: messages_body_length
messages_body_length.value: ("messages"."html" IS NULL OR char_length("messages"."html") BETWEEN 1 AND 300000) AND ("messages"."text_body" IS NULL OR char_length("messages"."text_body") BETWEEN 1 AND 300000)

messages_failure_reason_iff_failed.name: messages_failure_reason_iff_failed
messages_failure_reason_iff_failed.value: ("messages"."status" = 'failed') = ("messages"."failure_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("messages"."failure_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("messages"."failure_reason") BETWEEN 1 AND 500)
